text:
Priya: Morning — quick sync on integrator bootcamp (May 12). Core ask: 2-day hands-on labs (marketplace listing + hardware integration), a lightweight certification track, and joint announcement checklist. Need curriculum, lab machines, and assets. cc: @Marta @Diego

Diego: Love it. Quick Q — can we run the hardware day in us-west-2 or do we need the partner's lab?

Priya: Prefer partner lab in SFO (NVIDIA A100s/A10x). Redwood can provide a prebuilt docker image and access tokens. Cost estimate in doc: https://go.redwood.dev/partners/bootcamp-costs

Marta: For sales enablement we'll need: 30-min replay, 1-pager partner checklist, and a short slide deck with marketplace steps.

Oliver: I'll own replay + infra. Will create a `partner-starter` repo with terraform modules. Example run:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/partner-lab:latest 
# then run ./scripts/load-demo-data.sh
```

Diego: Certification idea — two tiers: "Integrator Verified" (proctored hands-on lab) and "Integrator Self-Study" (self-paced with quiz). Passing criteria = complete lab exercises + 70% quiz or short viva.

Priya: Agree. Marketplace badges should map to those tiers. Proposed announcement cadence: internal comms day 0, partner co-announce day +7, press outreach day +10. Need partner quote slot in slides.

Marta: I'll draft messaging and the checklist. Can someone assemble the partner checklist template? Suggested fields:
- required infra
- NDA status
- marketplace metadata
- demo script
- acceptance tests

Diego: I'll coordinate with OrbitCorp for a customer quote and confirm lab hardware availability. Also: partner NDA must be signed before hardware access.

deploy-bot: Deployed environment `partner-labs-sfo` created. URL: https://lab.redwood.dev/partners/bootcamp-05 — creds sent to approved emails.

Priya: Action items: Oliver -> infra + repo by Apr 28; Marta -> messaging + checklist by May 2; Diego -> partner coordination + NDA by Apr 24. Who volunteers to own the checklist doc?

Marta: I'll own it and post the doc link when ready.

Oliver: Repo PR incoming later today, will tag @Priya and @Diego.

Diego: Reached out to OrbitCorp. Will update here once they confirm.

Priya: :thumbsup: Let's do a 10-min sync Tuesday 9am PT to close blockers. I'll send calendar invite.
